**What happened, and what did you expect?**

**Which device or module?** (Proxmox, iLO 4, apcupsd, Uptime Kuma, Cloudflare, other)

**Lumina version and how you installed it** (installer, Docker, from source)

**Errors:** the card's error text (Instances page), and `journalctl -u lumina -n 50` if you can. Please remove passwords, tokens and addresses you do not want public.
